channel.title: Epic Fury Live — US-Iran War Tracker
channel.description: Live tracking of the US-Israel-Iran conflict. Real-time updates, verified casualties, evidence, and analysis.

item.title: ‘Sacred unity’: Iran’s supreme leader calls for calm amid political divides
item.description: Decree comes after hardline backers of the Iranian government accused officials of treason for signing an MoU with US.

item.title: At least 50 Malian soldiers killed in attack on military convoy
item.description: At least 50 Malian soldiers were killed after a joint Malian army and Russia's Africa Corps convoy was ambushed.

item.title: Lebanon’s President Joseph Aoun meets Rubio ahead of Trump talks
item.description: Aoun is expected to meet Donald Trump on Tuesday, as Beirut seeks US backing to end Israel-Hezbollah fighting.

item.title: Iran attacks US Gulf allies, causing a fire at Kuwait power plant
item.description: Kuwait and Bahrain report several rounds of Iranian missile, drone attacks; sirens reportedly sound in Jordan.

item.title: US and Iran trade fire after two US soldiers killed in Jordan
item.description: Kuwait says an electricity and water plant is on fire after the second such attack in two days. Iran says US strikes hit an under-construction nuclear power plant.

item.title: Laos says it can't determine cause of tourist deaths linked to methanol
item.description: Officials say they have no evidence of poisoning over the 2024 deaths because autopsies were not conducted.

item.title: What this desert city can teach the world about tackling heat deaths
item.description: Maricopa County in Arizona has some of the hottest temperatures, but it has reduced the number of heat-related deaths.

item.title: Watch: What to know as Genoa bridge disaster trial ends
item.description: More than 50 defendants have been on trial in Italy over the 2018 bridge collapse which killed 43 people.
